svg.title: Performance journey world map
svg.desc: A dotted world map. India is highlighted in maroon and the USA, Malaysia and Singapore in lotus pink. Dashed arcs travel from Bhubaneswar, Odisha, to New York, Chicago, Seattle, Palo Alto, Houston, Malaysia and Singapore.

g.title: New York, USA: Spiritual Retreat, “Path of Bliss” (2013)
Chicago, USA: Orissa Society of the Americas (OSA) Convention (2013)
Seattle, USA: ASHA for Education, Kirkland Performance Center (2013 and 2016)
Palo Alto, San Francisco, USA: Independence Day celebration (2016)
Houston, USA: Ratha Yatra, Orissa Culture Center of Houston (2016)
Malaysia: The Temple of Fine Arts (2014 and 2016)
Singapore: The Temple of Fine Arts (2014 and 2016)
Bhubaneswar, Odisha: the first listed stage, a book fair in 2003
